issues.description: The problem statement (UML and instructions) requires the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the attribute order from the UML: (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation uses a different parameter order: (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch will confuse students about the required constructor signature and will cause tests that check constructor parameter order to fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify the constructor in the solution (and ensure the template's expected signature when providing hints/tests) to match the UML order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } and assign fields accordingly. Alternatively, if the solution's parameter order is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to document the same parameter order so they are consistent.
